M2.name: Constrained-Gaussian marginal-equation residual test
M2.derivation: Joint Gaussian likelihood-score and raw-score residual fluctuations with exact model pattern covariance. Delta = argmin .5 Delta' A Delta - (Z_score+gradprior/sqrtN)'Delta over sqrtN*(native bounds-eta_MAP), A=I_model-Hprior/N. Reference residual sqrtN*E_model[h]+Z_h+G_model*Delta. All joint covariances retained, deterministic means retained. Boundary projection solved with full A; no pseudoinverse. Evaluate original S-X2 via squared weighted residual and separately named covariance-standardized Q.
M2.numerical_gates: QP KKT<=1e-7, 100 active-set iterations maximum; bread SPD kappa<=1e10; rank/eigen rules unchanged; test against independent scipy constrained optimizations. This is a Gaussian asymptotic reference, not an assertion of equivalent full bootstrap refits; fresh finite-sample confirmation is mandatory.

M3.name: Orthogonal marginal item-residual score (MAP plug-in)
M3.derivation: Exponential-tilt local alternative p_eta,delta(x) proportional p_eta(x)*exp(delta'h(x)). At delta=0 full nuisance score s, residual score h-E[h], C=E[s(h-Eh)']; efficient T=h-Eh-s I^-1 C. Efficient covariance E[T T']; Q=N*(phat'T)'Cov(T)^-1*(phat'T). E[T]=0, E[s T']=0 and E[dT/deta]=0; MAP prior/bound effects are eliminated only at first order, NOT assumed harmless for finite weak identification; evaluate size/power anew.
M3.gates: Likelihood I SPD kappa<=1e12, orthogonality residual<=1e-8; no pseudoinverse. Rank and deterministic null-mode rules unchanged. Never relabel Q as ordinary S-X2.
